conditions.name: Falha no processamento de ordens de servico
conditions.description: Exigido nominalmente pelo enunciado: 5xx em qualquer rota de ordem de servico.
conditions.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE message = 'request' AND path LIKE '/api/v1/service-orders%' AND status >= 500

conditions.name: Falha de integracao
conditions.description: Evento integration_failure emitido pelos adapters externos.
conditions.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE message = 'integration_failure'

conditions.name: Uptime — pods indisponiveis
conditions.description: Abaixo de 2 replicas significa abaixo do minReplicas do HPA.
conditions.nrql: SELECT latest(podsReady) FROM K8sDeploymentSample WHERE deploymentName = 'workshop-api'

conditions.name: Latencia degradada
conditions.description: p95 das rotas de negocio, excluindo healthcheck.
conditions.nrql: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) FROM Log WHERE message = 'request' AND path NOT LIKE '/health%'

conditions.name: Saturacao de recursos
conditions.description: Indica que o HPA chegou ao teto da ResourceQuota ou nao esta escalando.
conditions.nrql: SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) / average(cpuLimitCores) * 100 FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'workshop-api'

conditions.name: Autenticacao sob ataque
conditions.description: Volume anormal de CPF invalido ou inexistente sugere enumeracao.
conditions.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE message IN ('cliente nao encontrado', 'cpf invalido')
